title: Thalamic epileptic spikes disrupt spindles in epileptic encephalopathy
summary: Epileptic spikes between seizures can quietly impair cognition. When they reach the thalamus, they disrupt the sleep spindles tied to memory consolidation.

title: Demonstrating the state-space phase estimator
summary: A short demo of estimating the phase of a neural rhythm in real time — together with a credible interval that says how certain that estimate is.

title: Linking structural and functional connectivity in resting-state macroscale neuroimaging
summary: Functional connectivity rests on the scaffolding of anatomy. A generative model derives it from the structural connectome via the precision matrix.
